pages: Three today. The first took the grey water and stood up and walked into the wall until it broke its face, and the Master wrote: too fast. The second took it slowly, over a week, and is still sitting in the cell, looking at its hands. The Master wrote: too slow.

The third was the blacksmith's boy from the hill village. I knew him. He took it and he turned to me and he said my name, and the Master wrote nothing, and went and sat alone for a long time, and then he came back and wrote: again.
